question.text: The maximum permissible leverage for a Category III AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI has capped leverage at 2 times NAV for Cat III AIFs, computed as (Total Exposure: Long + Short after permitted offsetting) / NAV. The Trap: Cat III is the only category allowed leverage; 1x and 1.5x are incorrect; 3x is above the cap. Cross-Exam Context: Cat I/II (XIX-A) CANNOT take leverage except for temporary funding needs — Cat III is unique. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Model the leverage headroom daily and alert if the ratio breaches 1.8x (early warning).
